jobs.title: EA to Founder
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Most money apps talk at you. Cleo talks back ✨

We're not building another finance app. We're building the world's first AI financial assistant, one that actually understands your money and makes you better at it, and we're changing the world's relationship with money in the process 💰 For everyone, whatever their background or balance.

The proof: profitable, fast-growing, a unicorn with over $300M in ARR, and millions of people who now feel differently about their money.

We love original thinkers who challenge the status quo. We move fast, tell the truth, and there's nowhere to hide from good work here. If that excites you more than it scares you, you'll fit right in.

Follow us on LinkedIn for new features and the occasional roast 🔥

About The Role ✍️

We’re hiring a highly organised and proactive Executive Assistant to support Barney, Cleo’s CEO and Founder. This is more than diary management: you’ll help him operate at his best by driving projects forward, improving how work gets done, and ensuring the business follows through on its highest-priority decisions.

Key responsibilities for this role include:

  • Proactively manage Barney’s schedule, travel, and logistics, resolving conflicts before they become problems; provide occasional support to other execs.

  • Prepare for key meetings with clear briefings, stakeholder coordination, and rigorous follow-up on decisions and actions.

  • Drive projects and business-wide coordination on Barney’s behalf, including ownership of the company newsletter.

  • Act as a trusted liaison for internal teams and external partners, managing communications and keeping work moving.

  • Identify and implement workflow improvements that reduce administrative load and increase effectiveness.

  • Support personal administration, including bills and appointments, with complete discretion and sound judgement.

What We're Looking For 🕵️

  • 5+ years in an Executive Assistant or similar role, ideally in a fast-paced startup or supporting senior executives

  • Experience in project management or process improvement is a plus

  • Experience managing or coordinating others preferred

  • Exceptional organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail

  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication

  • High level of autonomy and flexibility in a dynamic, fast-changing environment

  • High EQ, discretion, and sound judgement when handling sensitive information

  • Proactive and self-motivated - you don't wait for instructions

  • Strong sense of ownership and drive to deliver results

  • Values communication, collaboration, and continuous improvement

  • Resourceful and thrives under pressure

  • High integrity and professionalism; you represent Cleo and Barney to the highest standard.

What we offer

We offer benefits package built to support you in and out of work. Benefits vary by country 🌍 and include meaningful equity, comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, mental health support, a paid one-month sabbatical after four years, a learning and development platform, pension or retirement contributions, and location-specific leave entitlements.

For the full breakdown on what's available in your location, visit our Candidate Hub 👈

What Matters

Cleo's mission is to change the world's relationship with money. We can't do that without building a brilliant, genuinely diverse team - and making sure our hiring process gives everyone a fair shot, running a fair and transparent recruitment process in which every candidate is considered on their metris.

We're glad to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process. If there's anything we can do to support you in showing us your best, please let your recruiter or one of the team know.

We may use AI-assisted tools during the recruitment process to take support the team in different ways like taking notes or referring back to conversations. They do not replace the team and all applications are reviewed by a Cleo employee thoroughly!

jobs.title: Internal Controls Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Most money apps talk at you. Cleo talks back ✨

We're not building another finance app. We're building the world's first AI financial assistant, one that actually understands your money and makes you better at it, and we're changing the world's relationship with money in the process 💰 For everyone, whatever their background or balance.

The proof: profitable, fast-growing, a unicorn with over $300M in ARR, and millions of people who now feel differently about their money.

We love original thinkers who challenge the status quo. We move fast, tell the truth, and there's nowhere to hide from good work here. If that excites you more than it scares you, you'll fit right in.

Follow us on LinkedIn for new features and the occasional roast 🔥

Meet The Team 👥

Hello 👋 I’m Kyle, VP Finance at Cleo. I’m excited to be growing our Finance team as Cleo enters its next stage of scale.

Finance at Cleo is about much more than reporting the numbers. We help the business understand its economics, make better decisions, allocate capital, and build the financial infrastructure needed to scale.

Today, our team of ~25 spans Controllership, Financial Operations, Treasury, FP&A, Strategic Finance, Capital Markets, and Investor Relations, supported by a dedicated Data Science team working across all areas.

We work closely with teams across Cleo, and we expect our people to understand the business, take real ownership, and master their craft.

It’s an exciting time to join: the company is growing quickly, the problems are getting more interesting, and there is a huge amount still to build.

About The Role ✍️

We’re hiring our founding Internal Controls team member to help Cleo scale confidently as we grow across products, processes, and geographies. Reporting to the Financial Reporting & Tax Lead, you’ll build on strong foundations to design and embed a robust controls environment across Finance and the wider business. Key responsibilities for this role include:

  • Design, build, and own Cleo’s internal controls framework across financial reporting, compliance, and operational processes.

  • Lead control testing and self-assessment across major business processes, turning findings into practical improvements.

  • Partner with external auditors on controls matters and support a smooth, scalable audit process.

  • Create controls playbooks for new products and entity launches, ensuring controls keep pace with growth.

  • Lead Cleo’s journey towards a public-company-ready controls environment, including SOX 404 or equivalent.

  • Champion a strong controls culture through training, guidance, and clear accountability across the business.

What We're Looking For 🕵️

  • Big 4 experience - ideally in the controls or internal audit team, but if you’ve been working in external audit, we’d still love to hear from you.

  • ACA, CIA or equivalent qualification preferred

  • Experience (either in-house or from a client perspective) in Fintech or regulated Financial Services companies is highly beneficial.

  • Hands-on experience designing and/or testing a controls framework from scratch.

  • Familiarity with SOX 404, COSO or equivalent.

  • Hands-on experience designing and/or testing a controls framework from scratch.

  • Exposure to multi-entity or multi-jurisdiction environments

  • Collaborative mindset - striking the balance between enablement and auditing

  • Strong communicator - able to translate complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders

What we offer

We offer benefits package built to support you in and out of work. Benefits vary by country 🌍 and include meaningful equity, comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, mental health support, a paid one-month sabbatical after four years, a learning and development platform, pension or retirement contributions, and location-specific leave entitlements.

For the full breakdown on what's available in your location, visit our Candidate Hub 👈

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Analytics (Organic & Brand)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Most money apps talk at you. Cleo talks back ✨

We're not building another finance app. We're building the world's first AI financial assistant, one that actually understands your money and makes you better at it, and we're changing the world's relationship with money in the process 💰 For everyone, whatever their background or balance.

The proof: profitable, fast-growing, a unicorn with over $300M in ARR, and millions of people who now feel differently about their money.

We love original thinkers who challenge the status quo. We move fast, tell the truth, and there's nowhere to hide from good work here. If that excites you more than it scares you, you'll fit right in.

Follow us on LinkedIn for new features and the occasional roast 🔥

Meet the team 👥

Here at Cleo, we have ~70 Data Scientists (Product Analysts) working embedded into our Pillars ✨ They stay connected and share knowledge consistently through monthly meetings and slack channels to scale approaches and ensure everyone learns in the same way. They thrive through clear communication with their squad and stakeholders to influence product or company decisions, being that bridge between the non-tech and technical sides of the team. We have deeply structured data and a great experimentation culture using StatSig for all analysts to dive into!

 

About the Role ✍️

We're hiring a Senior Data Scientist for Cleo's Marketing Analytics team (Organic + Brand), to build the measurement, attribution, and performance frameworks that grow organic and brand-led acquisition beyond paid. You'll be responsible for building the SEO measurement from scratch and defining how Cleo measures the emerging GEO channel, partnering closely with organic, brand, PMM, and growth leadership as well as:

  • Analyse performance across SEO, ASO, organic social, and other owned/earned channels, building foundational measurement frameworks with clear KPIs and diagnostics

  • Build Cleo's SEO measurement from the ground up and define how we measure and grow visibility in GEO, an emerging channel we want to lead on

  • Identify opportunities to grow organic contribution and reduce paid dependency through content, distribution, and optimisation

  • Partner with Brand and Product Marketing to measure the impact of major launches and campaigns, defining mid-funnel and brand metrics (awareness, consideration, engagement) and connecting them to downstream outcomes via causal methods

  • Contribute to cross-channel attribution frameworks spanning brand and performance activity, and demonstrate the incrementality of brand marketing

  • Design, run, and interpret experiments across organic and brand — from content/SEO tests to geo-lift and regional holdout experiments

  • Conduct cohort and funnel analyses to understand user behaviour from organic entry through to long-term value

  • Surface strategic insights and clear recommendations on where to invest, what to change, and what to stop

  • Act as a thought partner to Organic, Brand, Product Marketing, and Growth leadership on strategy, roadmaps, and investment decisions

  • Present insights and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders, turning complex analysis into actionable decisions

What we're looking for 🕵️

  • 3+ years’ experience in marketing or growth analytics, with significant time spent on organic and/or brand channels for B2C or subscription products, with hands-on organic experience preferred.

  • Strong SQL skills; comfortable exploring, transforming and validating large datasets independently.

  • Hands-on analytics experience with organic or owned channels (e.g. SEO/ASO, organic social, content).

  • Exposure to brand or upper-funnel measurement is a strong plus.

  • Practical experience with experimentation (e.g. A/B tests, holdouts, geo-lift or SEO tests) and interpreting results for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience with funnel and cohort analysis, and comfort working with mid-funnel metrics (engagement, consideration, intent) as well as revenue outcomes.

  • Strong commercial judgement: able to connect organic and brand metrics to acquisition efficiency, retention, LTV and profitability.

  • Ability to communicate complex analysis simply, with clear narratives and recommendations.

  • Nice to have: hands-on SEO/ASO or social/content analytics experience, Python or R for advanced analysis, and understanding of brand measurement (brand lift, tracking, causal inference)

  • Nice to have: experience shifting acquisition mix from paid to organic/owned or building new programs from scratch, background in consumer fintech or high-growth subscription apps, and awareness of (or appetite to pioneer) GEO measurement

What we offer

We offer benefits package built to support you in and out of work. Benefits vary by country 🌍 and include meaningful equity, comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, mental health support, a paid one-month sabbatical after four years, a learning and development platform, pension or retirement contributions, and location-specific leave entitlements.

For the full breakdown on what's available in your location, visit our Candidate Hub 👈

Cleo's mission is to change the world's relationship with money. We can't do that without building a brilliant, genuinely diverse team - and making sure our hiring process gives everyone a fair shot, running a fair and transparent recruitment process in which every candidate is considered on their metris.

We're glad to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process. If there's anything we can do to support you in showing us your best, please let your recruiter or one of the team know.

jobs.title: Head of Fraud
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Most money apps talk at you. Cleo talks back ✨

We're not building another finance app. We're building the world's first AI financial assistant, one that actually understands your money and makes you better at it, and we're changing the world's relationship with money in the process 💰 For everyone, whatever their background or balance.

The proof: profitable, fast-growing, a unicorn with over $300M in ARR, and millions of people who now feel differently about their money.

We love original thinkers who challenge the status quo. We move fast, tell the truth, and there's nowhere to hide from good work here. If that excites you more than it scares you, you'll fit right in.

Follow us on LinkedIn for new features and the occasional roast 🔥

Meet The Team 👥

Hi, I’m Taten 👋 Chief Operating Officer at Cleo. I lead the teams that help Cleo operate and scale effectively, spanning People & Talent, Legal, Compliance & Policy, Operations, and Partnerships. Together, these teams build the capabilities, relationships, processes and foundations that enable Cleo to grow responsibly while delivering for our customers.

We’re looking for people with strong judgment, deep curiosity, and a drive for getting things right. You’ll own your area, move quickly, and stay close to the details all while partnering with leaders and teams across Cleo to solve complex problems and drive meaningful progress. This is a great environment for thoughtful, enterprise-minded people who know when to bring others along and when to seek a different perspective. If you can balance principle with pragmatism, bring clarity to complexity, and want to help build a company that grows with intention, Cleo is a place where you can have real impact.

About The Role ✍️

We’re hiring a Head of Fraud to lead Cleo’s fraud strategy across debit, credit, identity, and operational risk - starting in the US and expanding globally. You’ll set the direction and lead hands-on execution, partnering with Credit, Product, Engineering, and Operations to build scalable controls that reduce loss while protecting customer experience. Key responsibilities for this role include:

  • Own Cleo’s end-to-end fraud strategy across transaction, identity, and operational fraud.

  • Set fraud risk frameworks, guardrails, and performance targets, balancing loss, approval rates, and customer friction.

  • Partner across teams to design, measure, and continuously improve fraud controls and workflows.

  • Lead fraud investigations, incident reviews, chargeback operations, and dispute management.

  • Evaluate and manage fraud and KYC vendors, informing buy-vs-build decisions.

  • Ensure compliance with relevant US card, KYC, and financial-crime requirements, with UK scope to follow.

  • Report fraud performance and risk posture to senior leadership and contribute to board-level risk discussions.

What We're Looking For 🕵️

  • First-line-of-defense fraud experience - you've done the thing, not just overseen it

  • Experience across both debit and credit transaction fraud

  • Identity fraud expertise: ATO, synthetic identities, KYC platform management

  • Operational fraud experience: chargeback investigation and management

  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills - comfortable defending a guardrail or threshold with data, not just intuition

  • Track record of working closely with credit risk teams and aligning on shared metrics, definitions, and trade-offs

  • US market fraud experience - familiar with US card regulations, CFPB, and the regulatory differences vs. UK

  • Background in fintech with lending or credit products (not just pure payments)

  • Vendor evaluation experience - you know the fraud tooling landscape and can make strong buy vs. build decisions

  • Track record of shaping fraud strategy and frameworks at scale

  • Senior gravitas and consensus-building ability - you can align product, ops, credit, and compliance teams

  • 8+ years in fraud or financial crime

  • Nice to have: UK fraud and FCA regulatory knowledge; disputes and chargeback management experience in a card-oriented business; relevant certifications (CFE, CAMS, CFCS)

What we offer

We offer benefits package built to support you in and out of work. Benefits vary by country 🌍 and include meaningful equity, comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, mental health support, a paid one-month sabbatical after four years, a learning and development platform, pension or retirement contributions, and location-specific leave entitlements.

For the full breakdown on what's available in your location, visit our Candidate Hub 👈

We’re looking for people with strong judgment, deep curiosity, and a drive for getting things right. You’ll own your area, move quickly, and stay close to the details all while partnering with leaders and teams across Cleo to solve complex problems and drive meaningful progress. This is a great environment for thoughtful, enterprise-minded people who know when to bring others along and when to seek a different perspective. If you can balance principle with pragmatism, bring clarity to complexity, and want to help build a company that grows with intention, Cleo is a place where you can have real impact.




ABOUT THE ROLE ✍️

We’re hiring a Head of Fraud to lead Cleo’s fraud strategy across debit, credit, identity, and operational risk - starting in the US and expanding globally. You’ll set the direction and lead hands-on execution, partnering with Credit, Product, Engineering, and Operations to build scalable controls that reduce loss while protecting customer experience. Key responsibilities for this role include:

 - Own Cleo’s end-to-end fraud strategy across transaction, identity, and operational fraud.

 - Set fraud risk frameworks, guardrails, and performance targets, balancing loss, approval rates, and customer friction.

 - Partner across teams to design, measure, and continuously improve fraud controls and workflows.

 - Lead fraud investigations, incident reviews, chargeback operations, and dispute management.

 - Evaluate and manage fraud and KYC vendors, informing buy-vs-build decisions.

 - Ensure compliance with relevant US card, KYC, and financial-crime requirements, with UK scope to follow.

 - Report fraud performance and risk posture to senior leadership and contribute to board-level risk discussions.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🕵️

 - First-line-of-defense fraud experience - you've done the thing, not just overseen it

 - Experience across both debit and credit transaction fraud

 - Identity fraud expertise: ATO, synthetic identities, KYC platform management

 - Operational fraud experience: chargeback investigation and management

 - Strong analytical and quantitative skills - comfortable defending a guardrail or threshold with data, not just intuition

 - Track record of working closely with credit risk teams and aligning on shared metrics, definitions, and trade-offs

 - US market fraud experience - familiar with US card regulations, CFPB, and the regulatory differences vs. UK

 - Background in fintech with lending or credit products (not just pure payments)

 - Vendor evaluation experience - you know the fraud tooling landscape and can make strong buy vs. build decisions

 - Track record of shaping fraud strategy and frameworks at scale

 - Senior gravitas and consensus-building ability - you can align product, ops, credit, and compliance teams

 - 8+ years in fraud or financial crime

 - Nice to have: UK fraud and FCA regulatory knowledge; disputes and chargeback management experience in a card-oriented business; relevant certifications (CFE, CAMS, CFCS)


WHAT WE OFFER

We offer benefits package built to support you in and out of work. Benefits vary by country 🌍 and include meaningful equity, comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, mental health support, a paid one-month sabbatical after four years, a learning and development platform, pension or retirement contributions, and location-specific leave entitlements.

For the full breakdown on what's available in your location, visit our Candidate Hub https://meetcleo.notion.site/Cleo-Candidate-Hub-3b95c63b874580e9a068fdc6c8929ebf 👈

Cleo's mission is to change the world's relationship with money. We can't do that without building a brilliant, genuinely diverse team - and making sure our hiring process gives everyone a fair shot, running a fair and transparent recruitment process in which every candidate is considered on their metris.

We're glad to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process. If there's anything we can do to support you in showing us your best, please let your recruiter or one of the team know.

We may use AI-assisted tools during the recruitment process to take support the team in different ways like taking notes or referring back to conversations. They do not replace the team and all applications are reviewed by a Cleo employee thoroughly!

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Most money apps talk at you. Cleo talks back ✨

We're not building another finance app. We're building the world's first AI financial assistant, one that actually understands your money and makes you better at it, and we're changing the world's relationship with money in the process 💰 For everyone, whatever their background or balance.

The proof: profitable, fast-growing, a unicorn with over $300M in ARR, and millions of people who now feel differently about their money.

We love original thinkers who challenge the status quo. We move fast, tell the truth, and there's nowhere to hide from good work here. If that excites you more than it scares you, you'll fit right in.

Follow us on LinkedIn for new features and the occasional roast 🔥

Meet The Team 👥

Hello 👋 I'm Jack, VP of Design at Cleo. I'm excited to be growing the Experience Chapter as Cleo enters its next stage of scale.

We're a team of 50 designers, researchers and writers working at the cutting edge of AI. We care deeply about clarity of thinking, creating exceptional end-to-end experiences and delivering high-quality work at every stage of the design process.

We've spent the past six months overhauling how great product gets made at Cleo, with the latest tools and models built into our process. Many of the team work directly in code, building our own design tools, creating high fidelity prototypes and shipping to production.

But, it's not only a process change - it's a product change. We're rethinking the UX of the product from the ground up, around fully agentic financial assistants that can run your financial life.

We expect our people to get genuinely close to the business, take real ownership of problems, and move comfortably between big picture thinking and the detail of making something incredibly good.

It's an exciting time to join: so much of this is being built for the first time 🚀

About The Role ✍️

We are currently hiring Lead Product Designers (IC) for a few Pillars across Cleo including Borrow 💰 and Subscribers 📈 Working alongside your squad run by a Product Manager, you'll be responsible for:

  • Identifying new product opportunities by deeply understanding user problems, industry trends, and Cleo’s unique strengths

  • Leading early-stage ideation, sketch bold product directions, and prototype innovative concepts

  • Designing and run lean research and testing processes to quickly validate or de-risk assumptions

  • Bringing your squad together to form and communicate a vision

  • Executing designs in polished UI in close collaboration with developers

  • Collaborating with cross functional stakeholders to shape product direction

  • Craft compelling visual and verbal narratives to communicate the value and potential of new product ideas

  • Building strategic business cases using customer insight, data, and market understanding to advocate for promising concepts

What We're Looking For 🕵️

  • You should ideally have several years of relevant experience and passion for growth focused work at a senior+ level

  • Experience in consumer-facing fintech or personal finance products

  • You can share mobile app focused design work that shows a proven track record of high quality execution in high-growth, fast-paced and product-led businesses

  • You are a strongly outcome-focused designer motivated by balancing business goals and user experience via small, quick, incremental experiment led impact

  • You thrive on getting deep into the data and the details to optimise existing features and journeys

  • You are a proactive problem solver who can effectively bring structure to large or ambiguous problems to generate buy-in from stakeholders

  • You are a strong cross-functional collaborator who can partner successfully with tech and marketing stakeholders to deliver bottom line impact on growth

What we offer

We offer benefits package built to support you in and out of work. Benefits vary by country 🌍 and include meaningful equity, comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, mental health support, a paid one-month sabbatical after four years, a learning and development platform, pension or retirement contributions, and location-specific leave entitlements.

For the full breakdown on what's available in your location, visit our Candidate Hub 👈

What Matters

Cleo's mission is to change the world's relationship with money. We can't do that without building a brilliant, genuinely diverse team - and making sure our hiring process gives everyone a fair shot, running a fair and transparent recruitment process in which every candidate is considered on their metris.

We're glad to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process. If there's anything we can do to support you in showing us your best, please let your recruiter or one of the team know.

We may use AI-assisted tools during the recruitment process to take support the team in different ways like taking notes or referring back to conversations. They do not replace the team and all applications are reviewed by a Cleo employee thoroughly!

jobs.title: Head of Data Science, Credit Risk Analytics
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Most money apps talk at you. Cleo talks back ✨

We're not building another finance app. We're building the world's first AI financial assistant, one that actually understands your money and makes you better at it, and we're changing the world's relationship with money in the process 💰 For everyone, whatever their background or balance.

The proof: profitable, fast-growing, a unicorn with over $300M in ARR, and millions of people who now feel differently about their money.

We love original thinkers who challenge the status quo. We move fast, tell the truth, and there's nowhere to hide from good work here. If that excites you more than it scares you, you'll fit right in.

Follow us on LinkedIn for new features and the occasional roast 🔥

Meet the team 👥

Here at Cleo we have team of ~135 member in our Borrow Pillar and ~8 dedicated to Credit Policy and Analytics. This function brings together several specialisms, all working toward managing portfolio performance; designing the systems, models, and controls that make lending sustainable. They drive to build and grow a portfolio of responsible EWA & Pay Later products that can scale across markets while protecting users from high cost debt trap.

About the role ✍️

We're hiring a Head of Data Science to lead credit performance measurement and monitoring within our Risk & Payments pillar. This is a player-coach role: you'll manage a team of Credit Data Scientists and Analysts, splitting your time between hands-on analysis and leading the team - setting direction, developing people, and owning the function's output.

You'll own the frameworks and metrics that keep our credit products healthy, and drive the deep-dive analyses that explain performance shifts and turn them into action. Key areas of impact:

  • Own credit performance measurement - design and maintain Cleo's risk metric framework (arrears, default, yield, LTV, marginal loss), and the dashboards/alerts that catch arrears spikes, roll-rate shifts, and decisioning anomalies early.

  • Bridge model health and business decisions - partner with Risk Modelling to translate model metrics (AUC, PSI, calibration, drift) into policy and product recommendations, and diagnose whether performance moves are model-driven, macro, or operational.

  • Lead root-cause analysis - own investigations end-to-end (question → analysis → recommendation) on issues like arrears spikes or yield compression, using driver analysis (SHAP, feature importance, decomposition), and present findings to Risk, Product, and Leadership.

  • Support policy and decisioning - work with Credit Policy and Decision Science to build evaluation frameworks for policy changes, quantify their marginal impact, and support elasticity/profitability modelling on pricing and limits.

  • Manage and develop a team - directly manage Credit Data Scientists and Analysts: set priorities, manage performance, and grow the team, not just direct project work.

What we're looking for 🕵️

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, comfortable working directly from the warehouse

  • Track record owning analyses end-to-end - from framing the question to shipping a recommended change

  • Hands-on experience with predictive models (credit, fraud, or similar), fluent in AUC/Gini, calibration, PSI/CSI, and drift

  • Fluency in credit portfolio metrics (arrears buckets, roll rates, loss rate, yield/marginal loss) and how they tie to unit economics

  • Experience directly managing analysts or data scientists - priorities, performance, and people development

  • Nice to have: experience with short-term or revolving credit products

  • Nice to have: experience with both UK and US regulatory frameworks

What we offer

We offer benefits package built to support you in and out of work. Benefits vary by country 🌍 and include meaningful equity, comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, mental health support, a paid one-month sabbatical after four years, a learning and development platform, pension or retirement contributions, and location-specific leave entitlements.

For the full breakdown on what's available in your location, visit our Candidate Hub 👈

We may use AI-assisted tools during the recruitment process to take support the team in different ways like taking notes or referring back to conversations. They do not replace the team and all applications are reviewed by a Cleo employee thoroughly!

Meet the team 👥

Hello 👋 I'm Kyle, VP Finance at Cleo. Im excited to be growing our Finance team as Cleo enters its next stage of scaling.

Finance at Cleo is about much more than reporting the numbers. We help the business understand its economics, make better decisions, allocate capital, and build the financial infrastructure needed to scale.

Today, our team of ~25 spans Controllership, Financial Operations, Treasury, FP&A, Strategic Finance, Capital Markets, and Investor Relations, supported by a dedicated Data Science team working across all areas.

We work closely with teams across Cleo, and we expect our people to understand the business, take real ownership, and master their craft.

It’s an exciting time to join: the company is growing quickly, the problems are getting more interesting, and there is a huge amount still to build.

About the Role ✍️

We are currently hiring a Head of Treasury (L5) reporting to the VP of Finance. As Cleo has scaled, so has the complexity of cash moving through the business - you'll bring together liquidity management, cash forecasting, banking infrastructure, funding operations and FX strategy into a single, scalable treasury function built for a fast-growing consumer lending platform operating across multiple facilities and geographies.

Key responsibilities for this role include:

  • Own Cleo's group-wide liquidity strategy, building short, medium and long-term cash forecasts across entities, currencies and funding sources, and translating them into recommendations on capital allocation and funding needs

  • Own daily cash positioning and treasury operations supporting Cleo's lending facilities - drawdowns, repayments, settlements and collateral movements - partnering closely with Capital Markets to ensure facilities run efficiently

  • Strengthen cash controls, reconciliations and audit readiness with Core Finance and Finance Operations, and establish treasury policies and governance that support scale and public-company readiness

  • Define the roadmap for treasury systems, data and automation, reducing reliance on manual processes, and build clear reporting and dashboards across liquidity, funding capacity and facility utilisation

  • Establish operating rhythms across FP&A, Accounting, Capital Markets, Engineering and Operations so cash movements and forecasts are coordinated, transparent and auditable

  • Own Cleo's FX strategy - identify and manage currency exposure across a multi-currency, multi-geography business, and run and improve the hedging programme, from setting risk policy to executing hedges and reporting exposure to leadership

  • Scope and hire your first Treasury Operations team member, then grow the function as the business does

What We're Looking For 🕵️

  • You've built treasury before - stood up or materially transformed a treasury function, not just run one that already existed, in fintech, consumer lending, financial services, or another highly regulated environment

  • Consumer-lending fluency, with an understanding of warehouse facilities, borrowing bases, receivables financing, settlement flows and bank partnerships, comfortable supporting multiple concurrent facilities alongside a Capital Markets team

  • Hands-on and strategic - you enjoy building from first principles (operating model, controls, systems) and are equally comfortable approving a wire or designing the policy that governs it

  • Forecasting and analytical rigour, having built models and frameworks that leadership actually makes decisions on

  • Cross-functional influence, able to bring Finance, Accounting, Capital Markets, Engineering, Product and Operations along with you and explain complex treasury concepts to an exec audience

  • Bias to action, zero ego - this role exists because complexity is outrunning capacity, and you'll ship a better setup quickly

What we offer

We offer benefits package built to support you in and out of work. Benefits vary by country 🌍 and include meaningful equity, comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, mental health support, a paid one-month sabbatical after four years, a learning and development platform, pension or retirement contributions, and location-specific leave entitlements.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Most money apps talk at you. Cleo talks back ✨

We're not building another finance app. We're building the world's first AI financial assistant, one that actually understands your money and makes you better at it, and we're changing the world's relationship with money in the process 💰 For everyone, whatever their background or balance.

The proof: profitable, fast-growing, a unicorn with over $300M in ARR, and millions of people who now feel differently about their money.

We love original thinkers who challenge the status quo. We move fast, tell the truth, and there's nowhere to hide from good work here. If that excites you more than it scares you, you'll fit right in.

Follow us on LinkedIn for new features and the occasional roast 🔥

Meet the team 👥

Here at Cleo, we have ~70 Data Scientists (Product Analysts) working embedded into our Pillars ✨ They stay connected and share knowledge consistently through monthly meetings and slack channels to scale approaches and ensure everyone learns in the same way. They thrive through clear communication with their squad and stakeholders to influence product or company decisions, being that bridge between the non-tech and technical sides of the team. We have deeply structured data and a great experimentation culture using StatSig for all analysts to dive into!

About the role ✍️

We're hiring a senior analytics leader to own the analytics strategy and operating model across Cleo's Financial Services Product pillars. You'll lead and develop the analytics leadership layer itself - L4/L5 managers and senior ICs - setting company-level standards for metrics, experimentation, and reporting across pillars.

  • Own the analytics strategy and operating model across Financial Services Product pillars - coherent measurement, experimentation, and insight cadence mapped to company priorities

  • Lead and develop the analytics leadership layer (L4/L5 managers and senior ICs), building a strong bench, growth plans, and succession so the function doesn't rely on any single person

  • Drive the experimentation programme as a product - fixing structural issues like single source of truth, standard bucketing, automated conflict detection, sizing and priors - and raise the bar on rigour across squads

  • Improve observability of live user flows and metric movements, partnering with Engineering on the event framework and product-health reporting

  • Champion responsible use of agentic AI as a force multiplier for analytics, with sensible guardrails

  • Partner with Product, Credit, Engineering, Commercial, and ML leadership to shape roadmaps and trade-offs with evidence, giving senior leadership clear visibility on what's driving key metrics

  • Set and enforce company-level standards for metrics, experimentation, and reporting, reducing duplicated, siloed work across pillars

What we're looking for 🕵️

  • 8+ years in data analytics, data science, BI engineering, or analytics engineering, ideally in a high-growth, product-led company

  • Proven management experience of at least 4+ ICs

  • Deep experimentation expertise beyond stat-sig testing - fixing structural problems in a testing programme: bucketing, conflicts/collisions, sizing, priors, governance

  • A builder's instinct: bias for automation, ownership, and shipping

  • Ability to set standards and an operating model that teams actually adopt, measurably improving delivery beyond a single team

  • Commercial sense - can translate product/user metrics into revenue, profitability, and LTV, and hold your own with Product Directors and Commercial stakeholders

  • Systems thinker, comfortable in a mature, complex product environment with interacting parts (e.g. payments, credit risk, ML models feeding user experience)

  • Exec-ready storytelling - can synthesise across pillars, land insight at the right moment, and set and defend targets with senior stakeholders

  • Player-coach instinct - creates leverage through delegation, templates, and self-serve, but goes hands-on on the highest-leverage or most ambiguous problems when needed

  • Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, Cursor) as leverage, with the judgement to know when to trust output and when to verify

  • Interest in fintech and Cleo's mission to make money easier and more human

  • Nice to have: causal inference depth (CUPED, Bayesian methods, PSM, uplift modelling) and the judgement to know when it's worth the effort

  • Nice to have: genuine enthusiasm for agentic AI as a force multiplier in analytics workflows

  • Nice to have: credit-risk analytics exposure - arrears, defaults, how ML risk models interact with product analytics and UX

  • Nice to have: fintech, personal finance, lending, or high-growth consumer subscription experience

What we offer

We offer benefits package built to support you in and out of work. Benefits vary by country 🌍 and include meaningful equity, comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, mental health support, a paid one-month sabbatical after four years, a learning and development platform, pension or retirement contributions, and location-specific leave entitlements.

For the full breakdown on what's available in your location, visit our Candidate Hub 👈

What Matters

Cleo's mission is to change the world's relationship with money. We can't do that without building a brilliant, genuinely diverse team - and making sure our hiring process gives everyone a fair shot, running a fair and transparent recruitment process in which every candidate is considered on their metris.

We're glad to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process. If there's anything we can do to support you in showing us your best, please let your recruiter or one of the team know.

We may use AI-assisted tools during the recruitment process to take support the team in different ways like taking notes or referring back to conversations. They do not replace the team and all applications are reviewed by a Cleo employee thoroughly!
